_note: Lalbagh Master Character & Clue Matrix — edit this file to change the story without code changes.
host_rules: Guests 1–8 are the primary suspects (including the Tender Coconut Vendor, who is the secret killer).
Guests 9–20 are investigators who hold eyewitness clues, solid alibis, and red herrings.
If fewer than 20 people show up, hand out cards 1 through 8 first, then distribute investigator cards 9–20 in numerical order.
Clue window for claimed alibis is 3:15–3:45 PM. Only the killer may lie when asked direct questions.

characters.title: Overworked Flower Show Coordinator
characters.secret_motive: Basavanna threatened to expose the cash bribes you offered an inspector to overlook problems with the Ganga display.
characters.alibi: You claim you were dismantling Glass House frames at 3:30 PM.
characters.whisper_clue: Botanist searched Google to identify a simple hibiscus plant.
